title: Market research cost: what drives price and how to budget
summary: Market research cost breaks down differently once you budget by program, not quote. See 15 cost drivers and a framework to plan a full year.
body_markdown:
How do I compare the full annual cost of a research platform with paying for separate agency studies? +


Market research cost comparisons only work when the platform's annual cost sits against every agency study planned for the year, including repeat waves, multi-market extras, and rush fees. On Conveo, the whole study runs as one plan from sourcing to synthesis, so teams take on more research and turn more of it into actionable insights while decisions are still open.


What costs beyond the platform fee should I include for recruitment, incentives, fieldwork, analysis, and implementation? +


A complete research cost model includes participant recruitment, participant incentives, fieldwork, transcription, translation, data analysis, and internal implementation time, since per-study bundling hides the annual total. On Conveo, teams recruit through 8 integrated panel partners or their own list via CSV or QR codes. Count reuse of past findings and existing data as an offset.


Can pricing cover repeat waves and continuous research programs, or does each new study cost extra? +


Yes, pricing can cover repeat waves, because Conveo is built for wave-based and continuous programs. Each wave is planned inside the annual budget and builds on the searchable insight library. Each theme links to the participants behind it, with video clips and verbatim quotes stakeholders can audit, which shortens reviews. Continuous programs make market research costs predictable.


How many qualitative studies would we need to run each year for a platform investment to make financial sense? +


No universal breakeven count exists, because the market research cost case depends on how many decisions need consumer input. Scope volume at 5 to 15 participants per persona segment. With interviews running in parallel across markets and time zones, teams that ran one or two studies a year can plan a full year of work and time each study to an open decision.


What pricing, usage, and renewal terms should procurement clarify before we commit to a research platform? +


Procurement should clarify credit usage, repeat-wave coverage, raw data export, renewal terms, and compliance. Start with market research pricing itself: Conveo uses enterprise, credits-based pricing, so request a quote. Confirm whether follow-on waves draw from the same credits. Confirm early that the platform is SOC 2 Type II certified, ISO 27001:2022 certified, GDPR compliant, and on EU hosting (Belgium).
